name: Muskauer Park / Park Mużakowski
description: Muskauer Park is a vast English-style landscape garden of about 560 hectares, straddling the Neisse River and the German-Polish border, where you can stroll from one country to the other across its bridges. Prince Hermann von Pückler-Muskau laid it out between 1815 and 1844, using native plants to shape the existing countryside like a living painting. Its green corridors even weave into the neighbouring town of Muskau.
